rule: A B2 gate closes only from a machine-verifiable artifact satisfying its frozen criterion. Missingness, prose quality or forecast movement never closes a gate.
terminal_policy: A preregistered failure branch may be recorded as FAILED and frozen without weakening its original closure criterion. B2-7 may close on a fully hashed negative B2 result; failed upstream gates remain visibly FAILED rather than relabelled CLOSED.

gates.closure_criterion: Protocol, evidence schema and feature dictionary are committed before any B2 claim record; predictive coefficients are zero pending calibration.
Versioned source/domain/document allowlist, deterministic query/page templates, independence clusters and archive rules are frozen before collection.
gates.resolved_claim: The pre-collection source/domain/document allowlist and deterministic query templates are frozen; only sources that passed direct smoke access are active for claims, while blocked/challenged routes are explicitly reference-only or inactive.

gates.closure_criterion: All admitted candidate, party, list and territorial IDs resolve without unreviewed fuzzy matching; collisions and unresolved aliases are reported.
gates.resolved_claim: The certified 92 local and 12 regional territorial IDs, all observed historical party/list codes and all 395 elected-member rows resolve deterministically without fuzzy matching; legacy 2026 candidate aggregates admit zero B2 records.

gates.closure_criterion: Same-cutoff candidate/list feature panel covers at least 80% of 92 local territories in both 2011->2016 and 2016->2021; feature support counts are published.
Authoritative coverage of all 92 local and 12 regional contests, with list presence, candidates/ranks and effective withdrawals/disqualifications; missing official coverage remains explicit.
Every admissible claim passes source tier, timestamp, content hash, territory/identity, deduplication and conflict rules; zero silently bridged conflicts.
Frozen ridge grid is fit on 2011->2016 and validated on 2016->2021; promoted features satisfy support/coverage and proper-score rules; all failed features remain coefficient zero.
gates.reason: The frozen 80% coverage precondition failed in both transitions, so the protocol failure rule forbids fitting or hand-setting predictive effects.

gates.closure_criterion: One exact evidence cutoff, append-only evidence hash, source-registry hash, feature matrix hash, coefficient hash and admissibility audit are frozen.
F0 preserves F-1, reports mechanical-only and calibrated-residual ablations, executes at least 50,000 coherent elections, and is append-only registered.

agentic_gates.reason: B2 is frozen, but F0 must be registered before any agentic experiment is preregistered or executed.
B2 is frozen, but F0 must be registered before any same-corpus reasoning experiment is specified.
B2 is frozen, but F0 must be registered before collection/reasoning ablations are unlocked.
